why: owner 25 Nov: faction colour, exact colours, letter outline, Questie in Persian

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.0-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1.71091

New
- Questie: its map and minimap pin tooltips ('[40] Terror of the Desert Skies   (Available)', '(Hold Shift)'), the NPC names on them, the quest lines under mob tooltips and the Questie tracker are drawn in Persian too. Switch: Quests page. Nothing of Questie is changed; without Questie nothing runs.
- Any colour, exactly: every colour row has a 'custom colour' button that opens the game's colour picker (live preview, Cancel puts the old colour back). The picked colour stays in that row's list as 'custom'.
- Letter outline: none / thin / thick outline around our Persian letters (Colours page), readable on any background.
- Factions and groups (Forsaken, Scarlet Crusade, Syndicate, Twilight's Hammer, Earthen Ring...) have their own colour (red by default) instead of the NPC colour: 508 markers in 413 texts.
